Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance:

Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NA Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: At O F Khamaria, CGM/(OF) KHAMARIA or his authorized representative 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. No.- 6770430100” is restricted for vendors who are established (established wit h MIL group of factories/erstwhile OFB) and registered for subject item with any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB. If any firm/firms participate in the bid & gi ve certificate that the firm is established (with MIL group of factories/erstwhile OFB) before bid opening and registered for subject item as mentioned above with (any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB) then offer of that firm/firms ma y be considered for technical evaluation, rest firms shall be rejected during tech nical evaluation. Established suppliers also have to get themselves regis tered for the tendered item if their registration has expired. 2- Offer of those bidders who are not established and registered source of the it em under procurement at OFK shall be rejected/ignored. 3- Inspection to be carried out as per inspection document i.e. QAP, Specificatio n & Drawings as part of TE & Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent along with the Supply. The Material will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the La b will be the Sole Criteria for acceptance of the Item. Place of Inspection & Authority:- at O F Khamaria, Raw Material/Advance Sampl e/Bulk Quantity: CGM/(OF) KHAMARIA or his authorized representative. 4- Bidders have to either submit Registration Certificate for same item with any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB for the subject item) OR submit duly filled vendor registration request form (VRRF) in case the firm is not registered or its registration has expired. For registration purpose the firm has to submit online VRRF form including all the required details & requisite documents for Capacity verification through vendor registration facility available at vendor.munitionsindia.in before tender opening date else its offer will not be co nsidered. Bidder while filling VRRF has to pay requisite application fee along wit h 18% GST for item registration and upload payment receipt details with the Bid . In case the online link does not work then the firm has to submit duly filled & signed VRRF offline including all the required details & requisite documents alon g with the Bid else the offer of the Bidder will not be considered. Further the Bid der also has to pay requisite application fee along with 18% GST for item registr ation through online mode only and upload the payment receipt along with the Bid. The format of VRRF and payment details (i.e. fees amount & Bank account

details) is available in “Buyer uploaded ATC document” section of the Bid Docu ment. 5. Advance sample as per QAP/Drawing/specification. 6. Bidder has to submit Udyam Registration Certificate for availing Purchase pre ference clause of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs). 7. Bidder has to submit the MII document/certificate mentioning the % age of lo cal content of material to be supplied. 8. Option clause: 50% OC applicable. 9 . DP shall include supply of full order including all the inspection process involving raw material inspection, stage/final inspection before bulk supply as p er drawing and specification. 10. Compliance statement is enclosed herewith. Bidder has to submit this compl iance statement completely filled & duly signed with seal of the firm. 11. If any firm is found as debarred/suspended for the subject item at any stage before placing of supply order, Bid of that firm will not be considered for further evaluation. 12. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to b e uploaded with bid: (i). I M/s. ....... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provisi on, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. (ii). If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 13. A Model ECS Mandate Format is being uploaded with the Bid. The Bidders ar e requested to submit this Mandate Format during tender finalization i.e. the fir m has to submit completely and correctly filled Mandate Format at the time of s upplying the material. 14. Performance Security deposit in favour of “Munitions India Limited O F Kha maria is to be submitted by the supplier as per TE terms & conditions if contract value (including all taxes) will be more than 5 Lakhs (within 30 days from the da te of awarding of contract). PSD may preferably be submitted online through SB Collect portal (link- “https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm”. 1 5 . Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’s hired labourers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 2 20/ton from the regular bills of firm. 16. Payment Terms- 100% payment within 30 days from the date of acceptance of material at OFK premises. NOTE: Bidders may please note that GEM is capturing & showing the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s)/Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with either

Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation. Note:- Eligible Bidders are requested to go through the attached Drawing, QAP/ Specification and Tender Terms & Conditions and should satisfy themselves bef ore participating in the tender. Any discrepancy should be intimated to the Buy er before Bid opening date. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
